messages.content: Using 'api_key_2', retrieve the IDs of graphs containing IP 145.34.45.56 on VirusTotal. Don't forget to set the cursor as 'cursor_b' and limit the results to 8.

function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Retrieves the current weather conditions for a specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which to get the weather, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA' if State for the city exists. 'City, Country' if State for the city doesn't exist.

unit.description: The unit of temperature for the weather report.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to use api_key_2 (which we have) to query VirusTotal API for graph IDs containing IP 145.34.45.56. We need to set cursor=cursor_b and limit=8.

We should call the appropriate endpoint. According to docs, it's GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}/graphs?limit={limit}&cursor={cursor}. So ip address path param is 145.34.45.56. Query params include limit=8 & cursor=cursor_b. Use header Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> where key is from our stored keys mapping: api_keys['api_key_2'] gives actual key value. Also Accept: application/json.

Thus request:

GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/145.34.45.56/graphs?limit=8&cursor=cursor_b HTTP/1.1
Host: www.virustotal.com
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <key>

Return JSON with data array each having id field etc. We'll parse ids.
